text: {"lessons":["I should judge each holding by its future prospects and contribution to portfolio risk, not by its average cost; avoiding a realized loss can keep me exposed to further declines.","Selling a winner feels good, but I should not take gains automatically while letting losing positions linger. Apply the same forward-looking review and rebalancing discipline to every stock.","After a long decline, a small rebound is not by itself a reason to buy more. Check the investment case, position size, and diversification, and avoid letting frequent account checks drive reactive trades."]}
